intervention_spec.name: Decay-gated linear attention (DGLA)
intervention_spec.comparator: causal ELU+1 linear attention, K=16, mixed regime
intervention_spec.change: input-dependent per-head forgetting gate gamma_t in (0.5, 1): S_t = gamma_t S_{t-1} + phi(k_t) v_t^T, z_t = gamma_t z_{t-1} + phi(k_t)
intervention_spec.motivation: linear attention accumulates every key into one fixed-size state, so filler tokens and earlier pairs interfere with recall; a learned gate can down-weight filler writes
intervention_spec.prediction: DGLA will match or exceed linear attention on near queries and will not exceed it on far queries (distance >= 128), because any decay gamma < 1 attenuates old pairs geometrically (0.5^128 at the gate's lower bound).
intervention_spec.extra_trainable_params: gate_proj: 128*4 weights + 4 biases = 516 per layer, 1,032 total (well under 5% of the baseline)
intervention_spec.persistent_state_per_layer: identical to the comparator: per head S (32x32) + z (32), FP32 = 4 * (1024 + 32) * 4 heads = 16,896 bytes; the gate adds no stored state
intervention_spec.attended_positions: all preceding positions via the recurrent state (no pairwise selection)
intervention_spec.development_selection_rule: no hyperparameter search; gate range fixed a priori; final 4,500-update checkpoint reported; development-stream accuracy logged at the prescribed checkpoints only for learning curves
